title: accept_loop is_tls: bool param should be enum
description: main.rs accept_loop takes is_tls: bool to distinguish plain TCP from implicit TLS listeners. A bool param obscures intent at call sites (accept_loop(listener, config, stores, true) vs accept_loop(listener, config, stores, false)). A two-variant enum ListenerKind { Plain, Tls } makes call sites self-documenting and prevents future bool-ordering bugs if the signature grows. Stays wrong: future callers will guess which bool means what.
